concerns.text: Under-reach: the idea's methodology sketch requires 'convergence plots showing correlation significance as a function of redshift bin AND cold spot threshold'. The spec covers threshold sensitivity (FR-005, SC-002) but nowhere requires reporting significance per redshift bin (z=0.2–1.0) or a plot of significance vs. redshift bin. Add an FR/SC for per-bin significance reporting.

Under-reach (minor): the idea lists final outputs as 'correlation plots, p-value table, and reproducible Jupyter notebook'. The spec covers the p-value table (FR-005) but does not state the deliverable form of the correlation plots or the reproducible notebook. Clarify the output artifacts so the deliverable scope matches the idea.
